messages:
eva: Heads-up — on RavenX-int4 canary we're seeing ~3.7% structured-output parse_fail for multi-turn toolcalls after retrying. Repro on dev-canary, lower on FP16. Anyone seen this pattern?

sunil: saw same. spike started after PTQ rollout yesterday. looks like truncated trailing array in ~50% of failures. :confused:

canary-bot: [alert] canary rtx-c2 RavenX-int4 parse_fail 3.72% (24h) -> created ticket #ML-7821

maria: can you paste a failing payload? small repro please. also which retry policy (default/backoff)?

eva: here's minimal sample (sanitized):
```
{"response": "...", "tools": [{"name":"search","args":[{"q":"foo"}]}  <-- missing ] at end
```
sunil: interesting — the model often emits the last token as 0x00 or \n prematurely. suspect kv-cache prefix alignment with batching.

eva: run config: batch_size=8, continuous_kvcache=true, retry_policy=immediate_retry(1)

maria: try immediate_retry(0) (no retry) and see if orig generation completes. if it does, retry replay may be re-injecting partial context.

jon: I ran a parity check earlier: int4 vs fp16 on small set. int4 had higher entropy in tail logits; post-quantization rounding pushes sentinel token below threshold. suspect quantized softmax noise.

sunil: logs show many reties re-attaching short suffixes. I'll dump the raw token streams to s3: s3://redwood-debug/ml/replays/1711160000/

evan: can we add a trailing sentinel in eval harness and enforce final char is '}' or ']' . easiest: post-process to append '}' then run jsonrepair? but worried about hiding real regressions.

maria: for canary, create A/B: (A) int4 current, (B) int4 + suffix_guard (force generate until '}' seen OR max_extra_tokens=16). Measure parse_fail.

eva: Agree. Also let's collect token-level entropy and last-5-token diversity metrics.

sunil: I'll schedule batch: 2k samples, seed 42, with and without retry, with suffix_guard.

canary-bot: scheduled job ml-canary-retry-gap-1711160000 (2k samples) — ETA 2h

maria: quick ask: please keep prompts unchanged; only change runtime flags. post results to #eng-ml with CSV formats.

eva: thanks — will follow up with sample diffs. assigning: sunil (run job), jon (entropy analysis), maria (eval metrics), eva (postmortem doc)

jon: one more thought — check tokenizer differences between runtime and eval harness; off-by-one tokenization can amplify tail noise.

sunil: noted. will include tokenizer hash in replay metadata.

eva: cool. if anyone sees immediate blocker for production, flag in #release-war-room. otherwise we'll wait for canary results.

maria: :thumbsup:
